proof_groups.proof_strategy: For both witnesses choose head_dispatch_case and nodes_dispatch_case to be the already-owned head/list. Reuse the original xizi_dll and xizi_dll_node resources under the anchor pure fact, then construct the post-update wand from an equality of result lists. In the member case the anchor is the explicit In premise and both result predicates are syntactically identical. In the sentinel case choose the equality arm of anchor, use the suffixed xizi_dll_head_not_in helper to obtain ~In head nodes without losing ownership, apply seed lemma xizi_insert_before_absent_append__dispatch_case_derivations, rewrite the transformed list to nodes ++ [inserted], and close the reflexive wand by direct wand introduction/cancellation.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The weaker dispatch contract can be instantiated with exactly the caller's current abstract list. Membership already proves admissibility in the member case. For the sentinel case the concrete cyclic-list predicate ensures the sentinel never occurs among data nodes, so insert-before at the sentinel is append. Once the transformed abstract list is identified, each residual wand maps a predicate to itself.
